scientific_integrity.basis: exact stationary conditional Gaussian mixture, Gaussian extreme-value scaling, and dominated convergence
scientific_integrity.prior_work_boundary: Previously established conditional reset-age structure, leading compact-edge law, and order-of-magnitude finite-size cutoff are explicitly credited.
scientific_integrity.priority_risk: A broader endpoint Gaussian-mixture maximum theorem may imply parts of the asymptotic calculation; independent literature-wide priority checking has not been performed.

scientific_limitations: Fixed positive drift, diffusivity, and Poisson reset rate; one-dimensional identical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles.
Complete simultaneous resetting to zero; not independent clocks, non-Poisson renewal, or interactions.
Stationary spatial maxima only. Fixed edge coordinate in the crossover limit; no changing-coordinate uniformity or error rates.
Numerical diagnostics are finite checks rather than proof or independent validation.
title: Gaussian-edge leakage and a Gumbel boundary layer in a simultaneously reset Brownian gas
